In the background, a large audience sits in dimly lit stands under bright white spotlights. The cat has a calm facial expression with eyes closed. (2) The cat performs a dynamic mid-air flip. Its furry body rotates backward through the rings. The camera remains steady as the cat completes the rotation, showcasing detailed fur texture and fluid movement. The stadium lighting casts long shadows on the blue arena floor below. (3) The cat extends its legs and tail into a perfectly horizontal straight line, holding its weight entirely by its front paws on the rings. The background audience is blurred but clearly visible, filling the rows of seats. The floor below is a deep blue color. (4) The cat releases the rings and lands gracefully on a blue padded mat. The white Olympic rings logo is visible on the side of the mat. The cat stands on all fours, looking directly ahead with a neutral expression as the crowd in the background reacts.
